actions_english.prompt:
Respond with detailed but simple instructions in English. Each line must consists of only one action, where the mentioned objects must be items from the following list: ['chicken leg', 'cabinet right door', 'cabinet left door', 'cabinet', 'stove on the left', 'stove on the right', 'counter top on the left', 'counter top on the right', 'pot lid', 'pot body', 'pot bottom', 'stove knob on the right', 'stove knob on the left', 'kitchen sink', 'faucet handle', 'fridge', 'fridge door', 'fridge shelf', 'salt shaker', 'pepper shaker'].

    Currently, you can see the following objects: ``the pot lid is on the stove on the left,
the pot body is on the counter top on the right,
the chicken leg is on the fridge shelf,
the salt shaker is in the cabinet,
the pepper shaker is in the cabinet,
cabinet right door is partially open,
cabinet left door is partially open,
fridge door is partially open,
stove knob on the right is turned off,
stove knob on the left is turned off,
faucet handle is turned off''
Use the following contexts for creating your action sequence:
Wash chicken and place in large soup pot.
Add water up to the top of the chicken.
Add bouillion cubes, celery stalks, onion and pepper (to taste).
Bring to boil, cover and let simmer for 3 hours.
Be sure not to burn the bottom.
Remove vegetables and chicken.
Break up the chicken meat into small pieces with a fork and put back into the soup.
Continue to lightly simmer the soup while you prepare the pasta in a separate pan, then add pasta to soup.
Place chicken in a large soup pot and cover with water (fill the pot about half full).
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Add wine, oregano, basil and bay leaves.
Cook over medium-high heat until chicken is done.
Remove the chicken from the broth and place in a colander until cold running water to cool.
Pour the broth through a strainer into a separate bowl to remove bits of fat and foam that have accumulated during cooking.
Pour strained broth back into soup pot.
In a large soup pot, cook chicken in water until the meat begins to fall off the bone.
Skim fat off stock.
Remove the chicken from pot, and set aside to cool.
Add pasta to stock, and cook for about 10 minutes.
Shut off heat.
In a medium bowl, beat 2 eggs with the juice of 2 lemons until foamy.
Whisk 1 cup stock slowly into the egg/lemon mixture.
Repeat with another cup of stock, and pour mixture into soup.
Bone chicken, and add meat to soup.
Stir well.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
